A '''cloud''' of tumbling [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] fragments occupied the eleventh [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position in the<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Aur system/Legends|Aur system]]. It was widely believed that the [[Aur Diamonds]], which included the cloud as well as the [[Planet/Legends|world]]-sized diamonds [[Aur IX]] and [[Aur X]], were created by members of the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestial]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> which had disappeared from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by [[30,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Aur system diamond cloud was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the sidebar that would have mentioned the cloud was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the diamond cloud was later released in [[2013]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Aur system, and therefore the diamond cloud, in grid square J-13.<ref name="EAOC" />
